run_logistic_regression_stan: run the LogisticRegression class to perform Bayesian logistic regression inference using Stan
format_data_to_stan: format an xarray Dataset into a Stan-compatible dictionary with X design matrix and Y response
extract_data_from_stan: extract Stan MCMC samples into an xarray Dataset with alpha and beta parameters
get_stan_model_code: get the Stan model code string defining data, parameters, and bernoulli_logit likelihood
get_inference_parameters: get the list of required inference parameters alpha and beta from LogisticRegression
